summary: 3 E Network Technology Group Ltd filed a Form 6-K reporting a securities purchase agreement with an institutional investor for a senior secured 8% OID convertible note (up to $2M principal, $1.84M gross proceeds) and a warrant to buy 468,978 Class A ordinary shares at $2.712 per share. The initial close of $1.5M note for $1.38M occurred; a second close is contingent on registration statement effectiveness. Boustead Securities acted as placement agent. This is a conventional PIPE/convertible financing, not a special situation; the filing lacks any acquisition, divestiture, activist, strategic review, tender, going-private, or restructuring elements. Routine capital raise, no deal terms beyond financing mechanics.
